reference.source: Psychiatry topic map (Marrow e6 topic selection only; text rewritten in own words, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: PTSD needs over one month; acute stress is 3 days to 1 month
Trauma focused CBT and EMDR are first line
Single session forced debriefing is harmful and not offered
Full major depression outranks adjustment disorder
reference.pathophysiology: Conditioned fear memory with impaired extinction and contextualisation (hippocampal) plus amygdala hyperreactivity and noradrenergic hyperarousal maintain re experiencing and vigilance; avoidance prevents corrective learning.
additionalDifferentials: PTSD versus depression (intrusion and avoidance versus pure anhedonia)
Adjustment versus normal grief (function and symptom pattern)
Acute stress versus PTSD by calendar only
additionalInvestigations: Trauma history with safety and safeguarding screen
PTSD symptom scales (PCL pattern) as adjuncts
Substance, depression and TBI comorbidity assessment
